methodologyNotes: This roster covers 9 handheld and portable car vacuums spanning corded 12V, plug-in AC wet/dry, and cordless battery designs, re-verified this session against manufacturer product pages (Black+Decker, SharkNinja, Cleva/Armor All, VacLife, Milwaukee Tool) and reputable retailer/distributor listings (Target, ER Industrial, and a Baseus reseller) where manufacturer pages were unreachable. Two draft entries were dropped: the Ryobi '18V ONE+ P718' (its only primary source was a spec aggregator, Ryobi's own pages returned 403, the real model designation is P7181/P7181K, and its HEPA claim contradicts Ryobi's own pre-filter/paper-filter assembly page) and the Hikeren 'H-305' (its cited manufacturer source domain does not resolve, so no spec could be corroborated from any reachable source). suction_pa is populated only where the maker publishes a Pascal/kPa rating; runtime_min is null by convention for corded_12v/plug_in_ac models and was nulled for the Worx WX030L where sources conflicted (15 vs 25 min). hepa_filter and wet_dry are booleans reflecting the manufacturer's own product claim, not third-party lab verification. weight_lb and dust_capacity_l were converted from source units (g, oz, qt, gal) to lb/L; Worx and Bissell weights were nulled where figures conflicted or could not be corroborated. A Dyson V8 Car+Boat kit entry remained excluded (no retrievable page). accessedAt 2026-08-16.

products.name: Black+Decker Dustbuster AdvancedClean Cordless Handheld Vacuum (CHV1410L)
products.priceNote: Street price (mfr page publishes none): roughly $64 (Walmart) to $74.99 (specialty retailers).
products.provenance: Re-verified directly on the manufacturer's own product page this session: 16V MAX (14.4V nominal) battery, 11-minute runtime, 605 ml dust bowl, 2.6 lb weight, cordless. No air-watt or Pa suction figure is published, so suction_pa is null. Filter is washable but not marketed as HEPA.

products.name: ThisWorx TWC-01 Car Vacuum Cleaner
products.priceNote: List price; Amazon frequently discounts to roughly $20-30 with on-page coupons (live price not confirmable this session).
products.provenance: Amazon listing title/features confirmed this session: corded 12V high-power motor and 16 ft cord. weight_lb 1.87 is the bare-unit figure (850 g) from the listing; some retail entries cite ~2.4 lb as package weight. HEPA filter is the manufacturer's own product claim (washable, spare included). No Pa suction rating or dust-cup volume published; runtime null because corded 12V.

products.name: Shark UltraCyclone Pet Pro+ Cordless Handheld Vacuum (CH951)
products.priceNote: MSRP per SharkNinja's own listing; the manufacturer site currently sells it at a reduced $69.99.
products.provenance: Re-verified on SharkNinja's own CH951 page this session: 10.8V battery, 10-minute runtime, 0.5 qt (0.47 L) dust cup, 3.09 lb weight, 'Fabric Filter' (explicitly not HEPA). Page lists MSRP $99.99 with a current $69.99 selling price.

products.name: Armor All AA255 2.5 Gal Wet/Dry Utility Vacuum
products.priceNote: Price per Cleva (Armor All's manufacturer); Best Buy lists a comparable $55.99-$75.99 range depending on promotion.
products.provenance: Re-verified on Cleva's (Armor All's manufacturer) own product page this session: model AA255, 2.5 gal (9.46 L) tank, 7.41 lb weight, 10 ft cord, 2 peak HP / 53 CFM, explicit wet-and-dry pickup, $75.99. Uses a reusable cloth/foam filter, not HEPA; no Pa suction rating published (CFM/water-lift only).

products.name: Baseus A2 Car Vacuum Cleaner
products.priceNote: Baseus's Amazon storefront shows the item unavailable with no active offer; third-party resellers range roughly $40-86, too inconsistent to state as MSRP.
products.provenance: Corroborating reseller page confirmed this session: 5000 Pa suction, 813 g (1.79 lb) weight, and 21.6 Wh rated energy (consistent with a 6000 mAh / 3.6V pack). runtime_min 25 is Baseus's published 'up to' figure (Amazon page unreachable/500 this session). washable HEPA filtration is the manufacturer's product claim. Dust-cup volume not published; price null because item is unavailable. Base 'A2' model, distinct from the separately sold 'A2 Pro' (7000 Pa).

products.name: VacLife Handheld Vacuum, Car Vacuum Cleaner Cordless (VL189)
products.priceNote: Current price on vaclife.com, shown discounted from a $99.99 list price.
products.provenance: Re-verified on VacLife's own product page this session: model VL189, 4.5 kPa (4500 Pa) suction, 20-30 minute runtime (25 used as midpoint), 1.46 lb weight, HEPA filter (spare included), 35,000 RPM motor, $36.99. Dust-cup volume and wet/dry capability not stated on the page, so both left null.

products.name: Bissell Multi Auto Cordless Handheld Car Vacuum (19851)
products.priceNote: No verifiable current US MSRP could be retrieved; Bissell's own product page returns 403 and the Amazon listing was unreachable this session.
products.provenance: Existence confirmed this session via Bissell's own support page for the 'Multi Auto Cordless Handheld Car Vacuum 19851'. dust_capacity_l 0.4 retained from the draft's prior corroboration (Bissell's commonly published cup size) but not re-verifiable this session; weight_lb nulled because the draft's 3.9 lb figure is dubious for a compact cordless handheld and could not be corroborated (mfr product page 403, Amazon page unreachable). Cloth (non-HEPA) filter is the manufacturer's product claim. Price and runtime left null.

products.name: Worx 20V Power Share Cube Vac Cordless Compact Vacuum (WX030L)
products.priceNote: Price for the kit with 20V 2.0Ah battery and charger (confirmed on Target); the tool-only version (WX030L.9) lists separately around $79.99.
products.provenance: Confirmed on Target's listing this session: 10 kPa (10000 Pa) suction, 6 oz (0.18 L) dust tank, washable triple-HEPA filter, $119.99 kit. runtime_min nulled because sources conflict (Target 'up to 15 min' vs the draft's teardown 'up to 25 min on low') and no single figure could be corroborated. weight_lb nulled for the same reason (Target 3.53 lb vs draft 3.88 lb). The draft's worx.com corroboration URL now 301-redirects to a EU homepage (dead), so it was removed.

products.name: Milwaukee M12 Compact Vacuum (0850-20)
products.priceNote: List price for the bare tool (no battery/charger) per an authorized industrial distributor; Milwaukee's own page flags the SKU as no longer available for direct purchase.
products.provenance: Re-verified on Milwaukee's own product page this session: M12 platform, up to 29-minute runtime, ~33 CFM airflow, reusable 42-pleat (non-HEPA) filter; page flags the SKU as no longer available for direct sale. Distributor (ER Industrial) corroborated $127 list price, 0.63 qt (0.6 L) tank, and 34 CFM. weight_lb 2.3 is the bare-tool figure (distributor package weight is 3.37 lb). No Pa suction rating or wet/dry capability published.
